_meta.description: Draft reference for InfluxDB measurements this project could add, based on real (but currently-uncaptured) fields found in FIT files during the fitparse -> garmin-fit-sdk migration (issue #26). This is a design sketch, not an implemented schema -- nothing here is written to InfluxDB yet. Field counts refer to docs/fit_field_inventory.json, a 143-file real personal FIT corpus (counts/types only, no real values committed).

existing_measurements._note: Already implemented in garmin_fetch.py (fetch_activity_GPS / _build_cycling_dynamics_point) -- listed here only for context, so proposed additions below can be compared against what already exists rather than duplicating it.

ActivityTimeInZone.rationale: Per-activity HR/power zone time distribution -- not derivable from any data this project already ingests. Highest-signal candidate found.

candidate_fields.ZoneType: str -- e.g. heart_rate | power, need to confirm exact field name/values from a real decode
candidate_fields.Zone1Seconds..Zone5Seconds: float -- time spent in each zone
candidate_fields.ReferenceMax/ReferenceThreshold: possibly present for context (max HR / FTP the zones were computed against)

open_questions: One time_in_zone_mesgs entry per activity, or per lap? Needs a real-decode pass to confirm.
Does it cover both HR zones and power zones in the same message, or separate entries?

ActivityRespiration.rationale: Breathing rate during the activity -- distinct from the daily/resting breathing-rate metric already ingested via a separate Garmin Connect endpoint.

ActivityHRV.rationale: HRV recorded during the activity itself, distinct from the nightly/sleep HRV data already ingested.

candidate_fields.HRV: float -- exact field name/shape not yet confirmed from a real decode

open_questions: Confirm field name(s) and whether it's a single time series or RR-interval-style data (which would need very different point shaping).

ActivitySplits.rationale: Auto-lap 'active vs. rest' split data, useful for interval-workout analysis -- currently only ActivityLap exists, which doesn't distinguish rest/active segments.

ActivityDeveloperMetrics.source_fit_message: record_mesgs.developer_fields / session_mesgs.developer_fields / lap_mesgs.developer_fields, resolved via field_description_mesgs
ActivityDeveloperMetrics.rationale: Real third-party sensor data (field shapes suggest a paired body-temperature sensor on at least one device in the corpus). Currently nameless -- neither fitparse nor garmin-fit-sdk resolve developer field names automatically.
ActivityDeveloperMetrics.candidate_fields: Unknown until field_description_mesgs is decoded and cross-referenced per developer_data_id -- this measurement needs its own resolution step before any field names can be proposed.
open_questions: Is this the same sensor/vendor across all 93 files, or several different ones? (namespacing may be needed)
Worth a generic 'DeveloperField_<n>' fallback naming scheme for anything field_description_mesgs itself can't resolve?

ActivityStrengthSets (FIT-sourced, name.rationale: Possibly redundant with the JSON-API-based exercise-set data get_strength_training_data() already ingests -- needs investigation before deciding whether this is a new measurement or should feed the existing one.
open_questions: Does set_mesgs carry data (e.g. actual weight) that the JSON API doesn't expose?
If redundant, is FIT-sourced data more reliable/available (e.g. for manually-imported files with no Garmin Connect activity record)?

ActivityGPS extension: running-form bala.rationale: Same family as ActivityGPS's existing Vertical_Oscillation/Stance_Time/Vertical_Ratio fields -- cheapest addition here, just two more fields on an existing measurement rather than a new one.
